```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_holders_without_credit_card
FROM acct a
JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = a.ref1
WHERE ds.a3 = 'south Bohemia'

  WHERE d.ref2 = a.accn_id
);
```
